sentences.text: The petitioners have already tendered an amount of Rs.40,00,000/- which is duly acknowledged by the respondent no.2, who is physically present in the Court.
The respondent no.2 further acknowledges receipt of an account payee cheque drawn on HDFC Bank by the petitioner for an amount of Rs.3,10,00,000/- dated 19 th June, 2023.
5. In view of above, the respondent no.2, who is identified not only by the Investigating Officer, but also by his lawyer, has extended consent for quashing.
6. Accordingly, we deem it fit to allow the petition as the prosecution against the petitioners cannot be taken to its logical end, in view of the stand by the respondent no.2-complainant.

7. The statement made by the learned counsel on instructions from the petitioner that the cheque tendered to the respondent no.2- complainant for an amount of Rs.3,10,00,000/- shall be honoured, is taken on record as undertaking.

In case if the cheque is dishonoured, the prosecution against the petitioners shall revive and be continued and the petitioners shall be liable to be proceeded against the action Contempt of Court for violation of the undertaking given to this Court.

10. Post matter for further compliance on 4th July, 2023.
